description: Installs test-proxvex-deployer at 0.5.67 (admin-only, no OIDC), then runs a Playwright spec that drives a UI-triggered RECONFIGURE against itself (adds addon-ssl). Exercises the same replace-ct.sh/lxc-start.sh self-switchover path as upgrade-via-ui.json, but via the reconfigure phase — which lost the switchover-result race in production (Step 11 OIDC reconfigure → 'Start LXC Container exit 255 / Failed' instead of a clean switchover). The spec asserts the task ends cleanly: old goes unreachable, the NEW container comes back AND now serves HTTPS:3443 (addon-ssl applied), with no failed execution surfaced.
